search_candidates.excerpt: Inflation Expectations After Five Years of High Inflation Many Fed officials have emphasized over the last several months that inflation has been above target for over five years. Their concern is that this lengthy period of above-target inflation could persistently raise inflation expectations or make them more susceptible to deanchoring if the current episode continues for too much longer. In this week’s Analyst, we draw on the past decade of economic research on inflation expectations and apply it to the current episode to assess how concerned we should be about inflation expectations. Three Lessons About Inflation Expectations We draw three main lessons from recent economic research on inflation expectations. commentary.summary: 7월 소비자신용은 180.62억 달러 늘어 예상 113.40억 달러를 웃돌았다. 종전 증가액도 141.73억 달러에서 145.55억 달러로 상향돼 차입 확대가 확인되지만, 신용 증가만으로 실질 소비나 가계 건전성 개선을 뜻하지는 않는다.
commentary.watch: 회전성 카드신용과 비회전성 대출 중 어느 쪽이 증가를 주도했는지, 카드 연체율과 함께 확인한다.

houses.summary: GS는 가계의 부채상환 부담은 관리 가능한 수준이고 카드 연체율은 정체됐지만, 서브프라임 자동차대출 연체는 계속 늘어난다고 진단했다.
houses.comment: 이번 신용 증가의 예상 상회는 소비 자금조달을 돕는 동시에 취약 차주의 상환 부담을 키울 수 있어 대출 구성 확인이 필요하다.
houses.limitation: 8월 25일의 가계 부채 분석이며, 이번 7월 소비자신용 증가액을 직접 평가한 사후 코멘트는 아니다.

commentary.summary: 8월 최종수요 PPI는 전월비 0.4% 올라 예상과 같았지만 수정된 7월 0.1%보다 빨라졌다. 에너지가 포함된 헤드라인 상승과 식품·에너지 제외 PPI 0.2%를 구분하면, 생산자물가 전반의 일률적 재가속으로 읽기보다는 에너지 반등과 남아 있는 근원 압력이 혼재한 결과다. AI 비교: GS는 PCE로 연결되는 항공료·의료 구성의 강세를 지적해, PPI 총수치만으로 소비물가 압력 완화를 단정하기 어렵다. Citi는 소비재 전반으로의 비용 전가 증거가 아직 제한적이라고 봐 품목별 확인이 필요하다.
commentary.watch: 에너지 상승이 운송서비스를 거쳐 다음 CPI·PCE로 전가되는지 확인한다.

houses.summary: JPM은 헤드라인 PPI 0.4% 상승이 에너지 가격 4.2% 반등에 주로 기인했다고 설명했다. 근원 전월비는 완화됐지만 전년비 압력은 높은 수준이라 결과를 혼재된 신호로 평가했다.
houses.comment: 예상에 맞았다는 이유로 물가 부담이 사라진 것은 아니며, 에너지 충격과 근원 서비스·재화의 지속성을 따로 봐야 한다.

Core producer prices increased somewhat less than expected in

August PCE report.

August still within the recent range. At times over the last few years, the low level of

This was clearly true in August, as the number of homes for sale at the end of the 
month increased again. The number of months of supply of homes at the current 
sales pace rose to 4.9, the highest since 2015. Existing home sales can also be 
somewhat lagging to reflect the downward demand impact from rising rates, as 
existing homes are recorded when the process closes, often a few months after the 
sale is initiated. As such, we expect the recent move higher in yields to continue to 
weigh on housing activity.

evidence.quote:
Citi’s view – Home sales have remained at very low levels since 2023, with sales in 
August still within the recent range. At times over the last few years, the low level of 
sales has reflected a combination of weak demand but also constrained supply. 
But in recent years, soft demand has been the larger driver of weak sales. 
This was clearly true in August, as the number of homes for sale at the end of the 
month increased again. The number of months of supply of homes at the current 
sales pace rose to 4.9, the highest since 2015. Existing home sales can also be 
somewhat lagging to reflect the downward demand impact from rising rates, as 
existing homes are recorded when the process closes, often a few months after the 
sale is initiated. As such, we expect the recent move higher in yields to continue to 
weigh on housing activity.

evidence.quote:
Citi’s view – Home sales have remained at very low levels since 2023, with sales in 
August still within the recent range. At times over the last few years, the low level of 
sales has reflected a combination of weak demand but also constrained supply. 
But in recent years, soft demand has been the larger driver of weak sales. 
This was clearly true in August, as the number of homes for sale at the end of the 
month increased again. The number of months of supply of homes at the current 
sales pace rose to 4.9, the highest since 2015. Existing home sales can also be 
somewhat lagging to reflect the downward demand impact from rising rates, as 
existing homes are recorded when the process closes, often a few months after the 
sale is initiated. As such, we expect the recent move higher in yields to continue to 
weigh on housing activity.
evidence.title: US Economics: Home sales fall on weak demand

commentary.headline: 일본 PPI 전년비 예상 상회, 수정 전월보다 둔화
commentary.summary: 8월 PPI는 전년비 7.6%로 예상 7.4%보다 0.2%p 높지만 수정 종전 7.7%보다는 0.1%p 낮다. AI 해석 초안: 예상 상회와 전월 대비 둔화가 동시에 나타났으며, 수정 전 7.2%와 비교해 물가가 재가속했다고 읽으면 잘못된 판단이다. GS 사후 분석은 에너지·쌀의 하락과 기계류 강세가 공존함을 확인했다. 당월 하락만으로 광범위한 가격 압력 해소를 선언하기 어렵다.
commentary.watch: 전월치 상향 수정의 품목별 원인과 수입물가·소비자물가 전가 여부를 점검.

houses.summary: GS는 8월 기업물가의 전월비 -0.2% 전환을 에너지·쌀 가격 하락에서 찾았다. 다만 전년비 7.6%는 여전히 높고 기계류 가격 상승은 남아 있어 전방위 물가 완화로 보지 않았다.
houses.comment: AI 비교: 이전 GS 프리뷰를 실제 발표 후 분석으로 갱신했다. 당월 하락과 높은 연간 상승률이 공존하며 환율·원자재 하락의 파급과 기계류 강세를 따로 봐야 한다.

evidence.quote:
BOTTOM LINE: The domestic corporate goods price index (CGPI) turned negative in 
August, falling -0.2% mom (July: +0.4%), marking the first decline since August of last 
year. In yoy terms, the index decelerated slightly to +7.6% from +7.7% in July, but 
remains high. While prices for petroleum & coal products continued to decline in 
August following July, prices rose for upstream items such as machinery. Due in part 
to the yen’s appreciation, import prices turned negative mom for the first time since 
June of last year.

Slowing shelter inflation, no signs of energy pass through to goods prices, and 
modest inflation in most services consistent with softening wage growth is not 
indicative of a reacceleration in inflation. Indeed, strength in August CPI was 
heavily concentrated in wireless telephone services. While these prices will also 
boost PCE inflation, this component has become much more volatile than usual 
after a methodology change in July 2025 and such a large increase is likely to be 
one-off. We would not be surprised by some pullback in this component within the 
next few months of data, resulting in particularly soft CPI as the trend of most 
other components has been slowing.

evidence.quote:
Core CPI rose 0.29%MoM in August but would have been very close to our 
benign expectation had it not been for a 10bp boost from a large increase in 
wireless telephone services. Such a large increase is unlikely to repeat, but 
there is substantial uncertainty around this component after a 
methodology change last year. Other details of August CPI were 
encouraging for further slowing in inflation. Primary rents and OER 
continued to slow and there are still no signs that higher energy prices are 
pushing up prices for other goods or services aside from airfares. With 
revisions, we expect 0.29%MoM and 3.14%YoY core PCE in August. Atlanta 
Fed wages have been somewhat stronger recently, in contrast to soft 
average hourly earnings, but wage growth is still close to a pace that has 
typically been consistent with ~2% inflation, and forward looking indicators 
suggest limited further upside.

evidence.quote:
Slowing shelter inflation, no signs of energy pass through to goods prices, and 
modest inflation in most services consistent with softening wage growth is not 
indicative of a reacceleration in inflation. Indeed, strength in August CPI was 
heavily concentrated in wireless telephone services. While these prices will also 
boost PCE inflation, this component has become much more volatile than usual 
after a methodology change in July 2025 and such a large increase is likely to be 
one-off. We would not be surprised by some pullback in this component within the 
next few months of data, resulting in particularly soft CPI as the trend of most 
other components has been slowing.

evidence.quote:
Core CPI rose 0.29%MoM in August but would have been very close to our 
benign expectation had it not been for a 10bp boost from a large increase in 
wireless telephone services. Such a large increase is unlikely to repeat, but 
there is substantial uncertainty around this component after a 
methodology change last year. Other details of August CPI were 
encouraging for further slowing in inflation. Primary rents and OER 
continued to slow and there are still no signs that higher energy prices are 
pushing up prices for other goods or services aside from airfares. With 
revisions, we expect 0.29%MoM and 3.14%YoY core PCE in August. Atlanta 
Fed wages have been somewhat stronger recently, in contrast to soft 
average hourly earnings, but wage growth is still close to a pace that has 
typically been consistent with ~2% inflation, and forward looking indicators 
suggest limited further upside.

encouraging for further slowing in inflation. Primary rents and OER 
continued to slow and there are still no signs that higher energy prices are 
pushing up prices for other goods or services aside from airfares. With 
revisions, we expect 0.29%MoM and 3.14%YoY core PCE in August. Atlanta 
Fed wages have been somewhat stronger recently, in contrast to soft 
average hourly earnings, but wage growth is still close to a pace that has 
typically been consistent with ~2% inflation, and forward looking indicators 
suggest limited further upside.

evidence.quote:
Slowing shelter inflation, no signs of energy pass through to goods prices, and 
modest inflation in most services consistent with softening wage growth is not 
indicative of a reacceleration in inflation. Indeed, strength in August CPI was 
heavily concentrated in wireless telephone services. While these prices will also 
boost PCE inflation, this component has become much more volatile than usual 
after a methodology change in July 2025 and such a large increase is likely to be 
one-off. We would not be surprised by some pullback in this component within the 
next few months of data, resulting in particularly soft CPI as the trend of most 
other components has been slowing.

evidence.quote:
Core CPI rose 0.29%MoM in August but would have been very close to our 
benign expectation had it not been for a 10bp boost from a large increase in 
wireless telephone services. Such a large increase is unlikely to repeat, but 
there is substantial uncertainty around this component after a 
methodology change last year. Other details of August CPI were 
encouraging for further slowing in inflation. Primary rents and OER 
continued to slow and there are still no signs that higher energy prices are 
pushing up prices for other goods or services aside from airfares. With 
revisions, we expect 0.29%MoM and 3.14%YoY core PCE in August. Atlanta 
Fed wages have been somewhat stronger recently, in contrast to soft 
average hourly earnings, but wage growth is still close to a pace that has 
typically been consistent with ~2% inflation, and forward looking indicators 
suggest limited further upside.

commentary.summary: 8월 근원 CPI 전년비는 2.4%로 예상과 같고 종전 2.5%보다 낮아졌다. 월간 상승률은 예상보다 높았으므로 연간 둔화가 최근 가격 흐름의 전면적 개선을 뜻하지는 않으며, 기저효과와 월간 압력을 함께 봐야 한다. Citi 사후 분석은 무선통신료의 일회성 가능성과 주거비 둔화를 강조한다. AI 판단: 다음 달 통신료 되돌림과 주거비 흐름이 지속성을 가를 것이다.
commentary.watch: 비반올림 연간율과 3개월 연율을 함께 확인해 2.4%가 지속 가능한지 점검한다.

houses.summary: JPM은 비반올림 근원 CPI 전년비가 2.446%로 사이클 저점에 도달했지만, 반올림 2.4%가 가까운 시기 저점이고 향후 분기에는 2.5% 부근에 머물 것으로 봤다.
houses.comment: 연간 하락은 긍정적이지만 이번 월간 상회 때문에 앞으로도 같은 속도로 낮아질 것이라는 기대는 신중해야 한다.

modest inflation in most services consistent with softening wage growth is not 
indicative of a reacceleration in inflation. Indeed, strength in August CPI was

boost PCE inflation, this component has become much more volatile than usual 
after a methodology change in July 2025 and such a large increase is likely to be 
one-off. We would not be surprised by some pullback in this component within the 
next few months of data, resulting in particularly soft CPI as the trend of most 
other components has been slowing.

evidence.quote:
Core CPI rose 0.29%MoM in August but would have been very close to our 
benign expectation had it not been for a 10bp boost from a large increase in 
wireless telephone services. Such a large increase is unlikely to repeat, but 
there is substantial uncertainty around this component after a 
methodology change last year. Other details of August CPI were 
encouraging for further slowing in inflation. Primary rents and OER 
continued to slow and there are still no signs that higher energy prices are 
pushing up prices for other goods or services aside from airfares. With 
revisions, we expect 0.29%MoM and 3.14%YoY core PCE in August. Atlanta 
Fed wages have been somewhat stronger recently, in contrast to soft 
average hourly earnings, but wage growth is still close to a pace that has 
typically been consistent with ~2% inflation, and forward looking indicators 
suggest limited further upside.

evidence.quote:
The first major regional manufacturing survey of September delivered a more 
cautious signal on activity while reinforcing concerns about inflation. The Empire 
State Manufacturing Survey’s headline business activity index fell to 7.6 in 
September from a cycle high of 20.6 in August, while the ISM-weighted composite 
edged down to 53.7 from 55.4. Although the report pointed to some moderation in 
manufacturing momentum, the broader signal remains consistent with continued 
expansion in factory activity. At the same time, several pricing and supply-side 
measures remained elevated, suggesting cost pressures in the goods sector remain 
persistent.
